Marissa / Dev — thanks again for the demo this morning. Our exec team is aligned that the next step is a short steering committee (30 minutes) to introduce Redwood to our exec sponsor and procurement/security leads.

Quick asks from our side:
- Can you confirm who from Redwood will present (exec-level intro + 10m product + 10m security/procurement Qs)?
- We need a one-pager and a proposed agenda to circulate to our CFO (Priya Anand) and VP of IT (Cynthia Vogel).
- Preferred dates: week of Jan 26 or Feb 2 — Priya is tight but can do mornings PST.

Happy to coordinate times if you send a couple options. Also include any materials we should share with procurement ahead of time.

Jordan

Thanks Jordan — great next step. Quick recap and proposed plan below.

Post-call recap / stakeholder mapping:
- Exec sponsor: Priya Anand (CFO) — decision maker for budget + strategic signoff.
- Procurement: Cynthia Vogel — will own procurement checklist and contract review.
- IT/Security: TBD from Cynthia's team (we expect one engineer to attend or follow up).

Redwood attendees (proposed):
- Marissa Cole — Customer Lead (30m facilitation + exec intro)
- Dev Patel — Head of Security & Privacy (10m on security posture + controls)
- Rachel Kim — Solutions Architect (10m product deep-dive / integration points)

Agenda (draft to share with Priya):
1) 5m: Introductions and goals for the steering committee
2) 10m: Exec-level value and deployment model (Marissa)
3) 10m: Security, data residency, and compliance (Dev)
4) 5m: Next steps and procurement/contract timeline (Rachel + Cynthia)

Attachments: I attached a one-pager and a draft agenda for your review (steering_committee_agenda_v2.pdf, redwood_solution_onepager.pdf).

Suggested times (all PST mornings):
- Tue, Jan 27 9:00–9:30am
- Wed, Jan 28 10:00–10:30am
- Mon, Feb 2 9:30–10:00am

Jordan — can you confirm which of these works for Priya? Also, Cynthia — please confirm who from procurement/security should be on the invite so we can include relevant artifacts ahead of time.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Adding a few procurement/security items for Cynthia and the team — wanted to list these so you can flag anything else you'd like before the meeting:

Required pre-reads we can provide:
- SOC 2 Type II summary + attestation (we will share link or redacted report)
- Data flow diagram + encryption/KMS details
- Draft SLA language and support contact model
- Short matrix on hosting modes (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and data residency options

Procurement ask list (what we typically see):
- Standard MSA + SOW with data handling addendum
- Security questionnaire (we can pre-fill or walk through answers)
- Procurement timeline — target 30–45 days for standard accounts, faster if we run parallel security review

I attached a one-page procurement checklist (procurement_checklist.xlsx) that Cynthia can use to triage. If there are any regulatory considerations (PCI, SOC, FINRA), call those out and we’ll escalate to infra leads.

Thanks — happy to present the security slides during the meeting.

—Dev
